bifrost: bifrost_app::view (springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs, controls.rs), bifrost_ui::anim (springboard/ui/src/anim.rs), render::motion (springboard/render/src/motion.rs); compositor springboard/src/gpu/layer.rs (not app-facing)
summary: Typed-property animation exists for views (frame, opacity, background) with transactions, completions, actions, springs (damping ratio or mass, stiffness and damping), media timing (delay, speed, repeat, autoreverse) and retargeting; key-path animations (basic, keyframe, spring, group) run through Window::add_animation. A retained layer tree backs layer-backed views, and app-facing views exist for shape, gradient, text, replicator, emitter (with sub-cells), tiled and scroll layers, plus TransitionView for content transitions and frame links for per-frame callbacks. The compositor underneath is not exposed to apps, and no layer class is a public CALayer counterpart yet.

gaps: No CALayer class hierarchy for apps: sdk layers.rs exposes LayerTree and LayerBatch, but layers are otherwise reached through ViewBase::layer and the layer-kind views.
Key-path animations reach only the view keys (frame, position, bounds, opacity, backgroundColor); transform, cornerRadius and shadow are not animatable keys on views yet.
Gradient, text, replicator, emitter and transition views are not yet checked on Midget.
No app-facing Metal layer or drawable (CAMetalLayer, CAMetalDrawable); the compositor is system-only.
Only the four public transition types; emitter sub-cells are one level deep.
Layer filters beyond background blur are not modelled (per-shader inventory pending).
